text:
Date: The Pallister Cup final race was held on 14 September 2023 off the coast of Veldmoor Bay.

Named person: Tobias Wrenfield, Chief Race Officer of the Pallister Cup Committee, confirmed Corrigan as skipper at the post-race briefing.

Figure: Seren Aduial finished the 212-nautical-mile course in 31 hours and 47 minutes, placing first among 18 entries.

Source document: The report rests on the official Pallister Cup Crew Declaration Form, filed with the Veldmoor Sailing Authority on 11 September 2023.
